segments.ja: 飛行船は、島の港に戻ります。戻る甲板は、リベリオの煙をまだ服に残しています。残している人数は、降りたときより少ないです。少ない欠席の中心が、サシャです。サシャの不在を、港の歓迎はすぐに理解しません。理解しない旗の横で、イェレナが志願兵の列を整えます。整える彼女は、この帰還を歴史の前進だと言います。言う声は、食事を失った班には大きく聞こえます。港の風は、飛行船の煙を壁の内側へ流します。
segments.en: The airship returns to the island's harbor. The deck that returns still has Liberio's smoke in the clothes. The number it still has is smaller than when they descended. The center of the small absence is Sasha. The harbor's welcome does not understand Sasha's absence at once. Beside the flag that does not understand, Yelena lines up the volunteers. She, lining them up, calls this return a step forward in history. The voice she says it with sounds loud to the squad that lost a meal companion. The harbor wind carries the airship's smoke inside the walls.

segments.en: On this return, Zeke is standing on the island's side. The position he is standing in is the Beast Titan, and Eren's older brother. The volunteers have made the older brother's plan the core of trust. The core they have made is to protect the island from Marley and, at the same time, end the world's hatred. The details of the method of ending it are not all opened today. Without being opened, he is under Levi's watch. The distance he is at is closer than the night of the assault. Being close is still different from trust.

segments.en: Armin hears the outline of Zeke from Yelena. The outline he hears is to stop the world's attack with the island's power, and after that to close the history of Titans. segments.ja: オニャンコポンは、感情の割れ目を、作業でまたぎます。またぐ作業は、船の整備と、次の燃料の説明です。説明は、誇張がありません。ない説明を、ハンジは信頼の最初の材料にします。する材料は、イェレナの大きな言葉より小さいです。小さいほうが、今日は確かです。確かな手を、アルミンも見ます。見る手は、世界を救う演説ではなく、ネジを締める手です。
segments.en: Onyankopon steps over the split of feeling with work. The work he steps over with is maintenance of the ship and an explanation of the next fuel. The explanation has no exaggeration. Hange makes the explanation that has none into the first material of trust. The material she makes is smaller than Yelena's large words. The smaller one is the more certain today. Armin also looks at the certain hand. The hand he looks at is not a speech that saves the world. It is a hand tightening a screw.

segments.ja: エレンは、港の歓迎の中心には出ていません。出ていない部屋で、彼はジークの計画をすでに自分の側で持っています。持っている顔を、ミカサは扉の隙間から見ます。見る顔は、船の中の沈黙と同じです。同じ沈黙が、義勇兵の希望と重なっているのか、彼女には分かりません。分からないまま、彼女はサシャの名を彼に再度は言いません。言わない選択が、今日の距離です。
segments.en: Eren does not come out to the center of the harbor's welcome. In the room where he does not come out, he already holds Zeke's plan on his own side. Mikasa looks through a gap in the door at the face that holds it. The face she looks at is the same as the silence inside the ship. She does not know whether the same silence is overlapping the volunteers' hope. Without knowing, she does not say Sasha's name to him again. The choice of not saying it is today's distance.

segments.en: Around Zeke, wine is passed to the soldiers of the watch. The wine that is passed looks like an extension of the welcome. Levi himself does not accept the extension that can be seen. The reason he does not accept it is that the better something tastes, the later it works. This episode does not yet prove whether it works. The bottle that is not proved is inside the volunteers' luggage. Hange adds the luggage that is there to a list. The one line she adds is a seed of later suspicion. The seed is still small today.

segments.en: The island the volunteers see is a base that saves the world. Jean sees the same ground of the base as a dining hall without Sasha. The two islands he and they see do not yet fit on one map. Without fitting, the ship is moored in the harbor. The moored machines are certainly useful. They are. Being useful and trusting are different verbs. Armin writes the different verbs on the left and right of a notebook. The left and right he writes are the real shape of this return. At night he reads again the verbs he wrote on the left and right.
